title: Zesty Chinese Chicken Curry
description: A rich and tender keto-friendly Chinese-inspired curry filled with zesty orange blossom water and a subtle bhuna finish.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced chicken and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped onion, minced garlic, and minced ginger, cooking until onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced chili, ground cumin, and ground turmeric, sautéing for 1 minute to release aromas.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally.
Add the orange blossom water and lime juice, then season with salt and pepper, and let it cook for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt, pepper, or lime juice to achieve the desired balance.
Serve hot over cauliflower rice or steamed bok choy for a complete keto-friendly meal.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
